Today, I join the people of India and friends around the world in celebrating a truly significant milestone in the public service of my dear friend, Prime Minister Narendra Modi - 25 years of continuous service as a Head of Government, spanning leadership at both the state and national levels.

On 7th October 2001, Prime Minister Modi began his journey as Chief Minister of Gujarat, serving in that office until 2014. In May 2014, he assumed office as Prime Minister of India and has continued to serve the people of his great nation through three consecutive terms.

This 25-year milestone represents a significant chapter in his long public service, spanning leadership at both the state and national levels.

Trinidad and Tobago and India share deep and enduring bonds of friendship, history, culture and kinship. These ties have been strengthened over generations and continue to grow through cooperation and mutual respect.

I especially thank Prime Minister Modi for his friendship and for the generous assistance and support that his Government and the people of India have extended to Trinidad and Tobago. We deeply value India’s partnership and its continued commitment to our nation’s development.

It was also my great pleasure to welcome Prime Minister Modi to Trinidad and Tobago last year, further strengthening the friendship between our two nations and peoples.

On behalf of the Government and people of Trinidad and Tobago, I extend my warmest congratulations to my dear friend on this remarkable milestone and wish him continued strength and success in his service.

May the enduring friendship between Trinidad and Tobago and India continue to grow and flourish for generations to come. 🇹🇹🇮🇳

@narendramodi

本日、モディ首相（@narendramodi）の首長在職25周年に際し、心からお祝い申し上げます。

インドの社会と国家の発展に長年尽力され、2001年以降は首長として長きにわたり卓越した政治的リーダーシップを発揮されてきたこと、インドの発展と国際社会における地位向上を成し遂げられていることに、深い敬意を表します。

また、本年7月の私のインド訪問の際には、大変温かいおもてなしをいただき、改めて感謝申し上げます。

インドの食文化や音楽に触れながら、日印の「特別戦略的グローバル・パートナーシップ」を新たな段階へと導くための施策について、モディ首相と具体的な意見交換を行うことができ、実り多き滞在となりました。

来年は「日印国交樹立75周年」を迎えます。

「自由で開かれたインド太平洋（FOIP）」の実現のため、戦略的方向性を共有する日印で、パートナーシップを更に前に進めるべく、モディ首相と一層連携していきます。

प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी के सरकार के प्रमुख के तौर पर 25 वर्ष की अवधि पूरे होने पर मैं अपनी शुभकामनाएँ व्यक्त करना चाहती हूँ।

भारत के समाज और राष्ट्र के विकास को साकार करने के लिए वे वर्षों से प्रयास करते आए हैं और सन् 2001 से अपने उत्कृष्ट राजनीतिक नेतृत्व से सरकार के प्रमुख के पद संभालते आए हैं। उन्होंने भारत के विकास को गति देने के साथ ही अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर भी भारत की प्रतिष्ठा को नई ऊंचाइयों तक पहुंचाया। इन सारी उपलब्धियों के लिए, मैं एक साथी राजनीतिज्ञ के रूप में सम्मान भावना व्यक्त करती हूँ।

मैं फिर से प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी का आभार व्यक्त करना चाहती हूँ कि इस जुलाई में मेरी भारत यात्रा के दौरान मुझे उनका बेहद गर्मजोशी भरा स्वागत मिला।

भारत की खाद्य संस्कृति और संगीत का अनुभव करते हुए, मुझे जापान-भारत की "विशेष रणनीतिक और वैश्विक साझेदारी" को अगले स्तर तक ले जाने के लिए उनके साथ ठोस कदमों पर विचार-विमर्श करने का शुभ अवसर प्राप्त हुआ। मेरी भारत यात्रा बहुत ही फलदायी रही।

अगले वर्ष जापान-भारत राजनयिक संबंधों की स्थापना की 75वीं वर्षगाँठ है।

मुक्त एवं खुले हिन्द-प्रशांत क्षेत्र (FOIP) को साकार करने हेतु मैं प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी के साथ मिलकर काम करना चाहती हूँ ताकि रणनीतिक दिशा को साझा करने वाले जापान तथा भारत मिलकर हमारी साझेदारी को और आगे बढ़ाया जा सके।

rawContent:
I extend my warm greetings to Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi Ji on completing 25 years as Head of Government at state and national levels.
This momentous milestone reflects a steadfast commitment to the well-being of the people and an enduring resolve to advance the progress of Bharat.
The transformation witnessed across our country in recent years is visible in the lives of people. From expanding access to housing, healthcare, financial services, clean energy and basic amenities to strengthening connectivity, digital infrastructure and opportunities, transformative initiatives have touched lives of millions across the length and breadth of Bharat. The remarkable progress in reducing poverty and improving the quality of life of our people reflects the scale and depth of this transformation.
Bharat is moving ahead with confidence and renewed aspirations, while the world looks towards India with renewed respect and confidence. May the people of India continue to benefit from your guidance and resolve as the nation advances towards the realisation of the vision of a Viksit Bharat by 2047.
I wish you good health, happiness and continued strength in the years ahead, as you remain dedicated to the service of Bharat and its people.

rawContent:
தியாகி இமானுவேல் சேகரனாரின் பிறந்தநாளில், சமூக நீதி, சமத்துவம் மற்றும் மனித மாண்பைக் காக்கத் துணிச்சலுடன் போராடிய அவரது தியாகத்தையும் சமூகப் பங்களிப்பையும் போற்றி வணங்குகிறேன்.

விடுதலைப் போராட்டத்தில் இளம் வயதிலேயே பங்கேற்ற அவர், நாட்டின் விடுதலைக்குப் பின்னர் சாதியப் பாகுபாடுகளுக்கு எதிராகவும், மக்களின் உரிமைகள் மற்றும் சுயமரியாதையை நிலைநாட்டவும் அயராது பாடுபட்டார். சமூக விழிப்புணர்வை ஏற்படுத்தி, இளைஞர்களை ஒருங்கிணைத்து, கல்வி மற்றும் உரிமை உணர்வை வளர்ப்பதில் முக்கியப் பங்காற்றினார்.

சமத்துவம், சமூக நீதி, சகோதரத்துவம் மற்றும் நல்லிணக்கம் நிறைந்த சமூகத்தை உருவாக்க வேண்டும் என்ற அவரது இலட்சியங்கள் என்றும் நமக்கு வழிகாட்டட்டும். அவரது வாழ்வும் தியாகமும் ஒற்றுமைமிக்க, பாகுபாடற்ற சமுதாயத்தை உருவாக்க நம்மைத் தொடர்ந்து ஊக்குவிக்கட்டும்.

On the death anniversary of Bharat Ratna Lok Nayak Jayaprakash Narayan Ji, I pay my respectful tributes to the great freedom fighter, social reformer and champion of democracy.

From the freedom struggle and Quit India Movement to Bhoodan, Sarvodaya and the call for ‘Sampoorna Kranti’, his lifelong commitment to social justice, people’s empowerment and democratic values continues to inspire generations.

May the departed soul rest in peace. Om Shanti.

rawContent:
Heartiest greetings and warm wishes to Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi Ji on completing 25 years of service to the Nation as Head of Government.

Your journey as Pradhan Sevak has transformed the vision of inclusive development into a nationwide mission, guided by Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, Sabka Vishwas, Sabka Prayaas.

Across my visits to States and Union Territories, I have witnessed Bharat’s visible transformation through improved connectivity, digital advancement, expanding opportunities and inclusive development. The greatest achievement of your visionary leadership is liberating 25 crore people from extreme poverty. It is a landmark historical achievement that human history can never forget.

May the Almighty bless you with good health, happiness and strength as you continue to serve Bharat on its journey towards an inclusive, prosperous and Viksit Bharat by 2047.

The true impact of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is reflected in the lives it touches.

rawContent:
Addressing the gathering during the foundation stone laying and inauguration of development projects in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, PM @narendramodi said urban development in Tamil Nadu is a major priority for Government. He said he has always believed that urbanisation is not a challenge but an opportunity and public transport plays a very important role in it. Good transportation improves people’s ease of living. Widening roads alone is not enough—modern cities need holistic infrastructure.

He further said that the country’s port infrastructure is being strengthened so that the shipping sector can reach new heights, with Tamil Nadu playing a major role. In this direction, the Central Government has taken an important decision and decided to develop VOC Port in Thoothukudi into a world-class mega container and green energy hub with an investment of nearly ₹17,000 crore.

#PMinChennai

rawContent:
🔰India’s Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses

 ▪️India is the world's largest producer of #pulses, a globally important, protein-rich food crop. Pulses contain 20-25% protein, more than double that of wheat and nearly three times that of rice. 

▪️Pulses contribute significantly to India's agricultural exports and remain a vital part of Indian diets, ensuring nutritional security. 

▪️Recognising this importance, the government launched the 'Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses' on October 11, 2025. 

▪️As the nation observes the first anniversary of the Mission’s launch on October 11, this landmark initiative continues its momentum, backed by a financial allocation of ₹11,440 crore spanning 2025–26 to 2030–31. 

▪️The Mission seeks to achieve self-sufficiency in pulses production. It focuses on boosting domestic production, reducing import dependence, and enhancing farmers' income through a comprehensive value-chain approach.

🔰A Mission with a Clear Target

▪️Under the Mission, by 2030-31, production is expected to reach nearly 350 lakh tonnes, with yield rising to 1,130 kg per hectare. Key strategic measures driving these targets include:

➔Focus on enhancing production of Tur, Urad and Masoor

 ➔Expands pulse cultivation area by 35 lakh hectares to reach a total targeted area of 310 lakh hectares by 2030–31

➔Cluster-based approach covering 489 districts to intensify production

rawContent:
🔰Next-Gen GST Process Reforms

▪️Introduced on 1 July 2017, GST brought many Central and State taxes into a common framework. It marked a milestone in India’s reform journey. 

▪️It gave effect to the principle of “One Nation, One Tax” and helped move India towards an integrated tax system.

▪️The 57th GST Council meeting’s recommendations address concerns across registration, returns, refunds, input tax credit and dispute resolution.  

▪️These recommendations build on GST’s success and mark another step in its continued improvement.  

🔰GST in Numbers: Wider Reach, Scale and Collections

▪️A wider taxpayer base: Registered taxpayers increased from around 60 lakh in 2017  to ~1.70 crore as of September 2026.

▪️A large-scale digital tax system: As on 30 September 2026, the GST System had cumulatively processed 3,053 crore invoice uploads and 833.82 crore e-way bills.

▪️Strong revenue growth: Gross GST collections reached ~₹12.46 lakh crore during April-September 2026, registering an increase of 11.6% Y-o-Y.

🔰Reforms in the Registration process:

▪️A comprehensive and detailed documentation along with FAQs will be issued for processing registration applications.

▪️The registration application will be amended to simplify the filing process and improve clarity for taxpayers and tax officers.

▪️The GST portal will provide a user-friendly interface for filing registration applications, with clear navigational paths, drop-down lists, tool-tips and contextual guidance.

🔰 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) on amendments in GST registration

🌀 How can I change the legal name of my business?

➤You need to submit an application in FORM GST REG-14 on the common portal. After successful submission of application on the common portal and on successful validation of PAN details furnished by you, the legal name will be amended by the system.

🌀 How can I add an Additional Place of Business (APoB) to my GST registration?

➤You need to submit an application on the common portal in FORM GST REG-14, along with the required documents as proof of the place of business, as specified in the list attached to FORM GST REG-01. The application will be processed automatically by the system and the APoB details will be added in the registration of the applicant.

rawContent:
🔰Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) on cancellation of GST registration

🌀In what circumstances can I apply for cancellation of my GST registration?

▪️Cancellation of GST registration can be applied for in the following circumstances:

➤Your business has been completely discontinued, closed down, or transferred fully for any reason.

➤There is a change in the constitution of the business resulting in a new PAN.

➤Your business has been amalgamated, demerged, or disposed of.

🌀 Is there any specific time limit in which I should apply for cancellation of my GST registration?

➤Yes, you should file an application for cancellation of your registration within 30 days of occurrence of event warranting cancellation of your registration.

➤However, in the event of death of a sole proprietor, there is no such time limit for filing application of cancellation of registration.

Read the full FAQs for detailed information: https://t.co/spVGlqmcMJ

विगत 9.5 वर्षों में अपराध और अपराधियों के प्रति जीरो टॉलरेंस की नीति, तकनीक आधारित निगरानी, पुलिस की त्वरित कार्रवाई और जन-जागरूकता अभियानों ने प्रदेश में महिलाओं के लिए भयमुक्त वातावरण के निर्माण में निर्णायक भूमिका निभाई है।

मिशन शक्ति के पांच चरणों, सेफ सिटी परियोजना, मिशन शक्ति केंद्रों और महिला बीट पुलिसिंग जैसी पहलों ने महिला सुरक्षा के तंत्र को व्यापक और सुदृढ़ आधार प्रदान किया है।

20% आरक्षण के साथ उत्तर प्रदेश महिला पुलिस कार्यबल 10,000 से बढ़कर 44,000 से अधिक हुआ है। साथ ही, लखनऊ में वीरांगना ऊदा देवी पासी, गोरखपुर में वीरांगना झलकारी बाई कोरी और बदायूं में वीरांगना अवंतीबाई लोधी के नाम पर स्थापित 3 महिला PAC बटालियनों का भी गठन हुआ है।

प्रदेश की डबल इंजन सरकार की नारी शक्ति की सुरक्षा से सशक्तीकरण की यह अहर्निश यात्रा ‘सशक्त नारी, समृद्ध उत्तर प्रदेश’ के संकल्प को साकार कर रही है।

2017 से पहले जिन बेटियों के लिए घर की चौखट पार करना भी एक चुनौती थी, आज वही बेटियां नाइट शिफ्ट में भी काम करते हुए प्रदेश की अर्थव्यवस्था को नई गति प्रदान कर रही हैं। प्रदेश के 50% से अधिक स्टार्टअप्स को आज नारी शक्ति लीड कर रही हैं। महिला कार्यबल भागीदारी दर 12% से बढ़कर 36% से अधिक होना प्रदेश में महिलाओं के बढ़ते विश्वास और विस्तृत होते अवसरों का स्पष्ट प्रमाण है।

मातृशक्ति के स्वास्थ्य से लेकर बेटियों के उज्ज्वल भविष्य तक डबल इंजन सरकार की कल्याणकारी योजनाएं नारी सशक्तीकरण को नित्य नई मजबूती प्रदान कर रही है।  

प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना और पोषण अभियान से माताओं एवं शिशुओं के स्वास्थ्य एवं पोषण को संबल मिला है। मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला और सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना बेटियों के भविष्य को आर्थिक सुरक्षा प्रदान कर रही हैं, वहीं मिशन शक्ति, ऑपरेशन कायाकल्प, कस्तूरबा बालिका विद्यालय, सेफ सिटी, रानी लक्ष्मीबाई स्कूटी योजना और लोकमाता अहिल्याबाई होल्कर वर्किंग वुमन हॉस्टल जैसी पहलें उनकी शिक्षा, सुरक्षा, गतिशिलता और आत्मनिर्भरता के नए रास्ते खोल रही हैं।

‘यत्र नार्यस्तु पूज्यन्ते रमन्ते तत्र देवताः’ की भावना को आत्मसात करते हुए प्रदेश की डबल इंजन सरकार ‘सशक्त नारी-समृद्ध उत्तर प्रदेश’ के माध्यम से ‘विकसित भारत-विकसित उत्तर प्रदेश’ के संकल्प को साकार करने की दिशा में निरंतर अग्रसर है।

मैदान में मेधा, उपलब्धि पर सम्मान और प्रतिभा को राष्ट्र सेवा का अवसर, यही 'नए उत्तर प्रदेश' की नई खेल संस्कृति है।

इसी संस्कृति को आगे बढ़ाते हुए आज उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस में कुशल खिलाड़ी कोटे के अंतर्गत चयनित 43 उप निरीक्षक (नागरिक पुलिस), 295 आरक्षी (नागरिक पुलिस) एवं 132 आरक्षी (पीएसी) सहित कुल 470 खिलाड़ियों को नियुक्ति-पत्र प्रदान किए जाएंगे।

आज खिलाड़ियों के लिए खुल रहे सरकारी सेवा के ये द्वार उस बदलाव की तस्वीर भी हैं, जो उत्तर प्रदेश ने वर्ष 2017 के बाद देखा है। इससे पहले खेल कोटा उपेक्षित था और भर्तियों में प्रतिभा से अधिक सिफारिश व पहुंच की चर्चा होती थी।

डबल इंजन सरकार ने खेल प्रतिभाओं को रोजगार व सुरक्षित भविष्य से जोड़ा है। इसी का परिणाम है कि विभिन्न विभागों में अब तक 534 से अधिक खिलाड़ियों की सीधी भर्ती हो चुकी है, जबकि उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस में 866 अन्य खिलाड़ियों की भर्ती प्रक्रिया भी आगे बढ़ रही है।

सभी चयनित खिलाड़ियों को उनके स्वर्णिम भविष्य हेतु अनंत शुभकामनाएं।

rawContent:
After Baruipur Court, Bankshall Court, Chandannagar and Salboni, another brutal attack today. This time at the residence of Sr Advocate Bikash Ranjan Bhattacharyya in Kolkata. Evidence on video confirms the brazenness such attackers have towards law enforcement in West Bengal. I strongly condemn such continuing attacks on the legal fraternity.

It is true that in the past 15 years Bikash da and us have often been on different sides of the ideological and legal divide. However, the line of decency was never crossed. We have faith in the Constitution and the Judiciary. However, today all voices of dissent are being crushed- from Parliament to the Assembly to Local  Bodies to Courts of Law. As an Advocate myself, I am short of words to express my solidarity, but I am determined to call for Unity Of Advocates irrespective of political  beliefs. We must save the Constitution, the Bar, the Bench, the State and, most importantly, our dear motherland. Our India. 

The “lawlessness” of West Bengal, with Cases of 2454 Rapes, 600 Murders, 13,114 Attempted to Murders and 32,341 Grievous Assaults in the past five months has converted itself to a State Sponsored Anarchy where Advocates, who are Officers of the Court, are being attacked throughout the State. Only a consolidated resistance remains to be the sole remedy.

राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ के संस्कारों को जीवन में उतारते हुए नानाजी ने समाज के अंतिम व्यक्ति के उत्थान, ग्रामीण विकास और स्वावलंबन के लिए स्वयं को पूर्णतः समर्पित कर दिया।

संगठन के प्रति उनकी अटूट निष्ठा तथा राष्ट्रनिर्माण में उनका अतुलनीय योगदान सदैव युवाओं के लिए अनुकरणीय रहेगा।

महान स्वाधीनता सेनानी, लोकनायक जयप्रकाश नारायण जी की जयंती पर उनका स्मरण कर उन्हें नमन करता हूँ।

स्वतंत्रता संग्राम में युवा शक्ति को जोड़ने से लेकर आजादी के बाद ग्रामीण भारत के सशक्तीकरण और सर्वोदय तक, उनका संपूर्ण जीवन राष्ट्र और समाज को समर्पित रहा।

आपातकाल के समय उनका 'सम्पूर्ण क्रांति' का उद्घोष करोड़ों देशवासियों की आवाज बन गया।

राष्ट्र व समाज के प्रति उनका समर्पण आने वाली पीढ़ियों का मार्गदर्शन करता रहेगा।

राहुल गांधी और INDI अलायंस के झूठ, भ्रम व दुष्प्रचार के बावजूद प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी के नेतृत्व में भाजपा एक के बाद एक चुनाव जीत रही है। पश्चिम बंगाल, असम व पुडुचेरी के उपचुनावों और हाल ही में हुए राजस्थान व त्रिपुरा के निकाय चुनावों में NDA को मिली जीत बताती है कि जनता ने INDI अलायंस को पूरी तरह नकार दिया है।

जनाधार खो चुके ये दल हर हार के बाद संस्थाओं पर सवाल उठाते हैं, पर जनता इनका यह चरित्र पहचान चुकी है। इसीलिए एक बार फिर प्रचंड जनादेश देकर भाजपा पर अपना अटूट विश्वास व्यक्त किया है।

इस जीत के लिए पश्चिम बंगाल के मुख्यमंत्री श्री @SuvenduWB जी, असम के मुख्यमंत्री श्री @himantabiswa जी, राजस्थान के मुख्यमंत्री श्री @BhajanlalBjp जी, त्रिपुरा के मुख्यमंत्री प्रो. @DrManikSaha2 जी व पुडुचेरी के मुख्यमंत्री श्री एन. रंगासामी जी सहित सभी प्रदेश अध्यक्षों और परिश्रमी कार्यकर्ताओं को हार्दिक बधाई।

भारतीय सिनेमा के महान अभिनेता नाना पाटेकर जी का निधन कला जगत के लिए एक अपूरणीय क्षति है। पांच दशकों तक उन्होंने अपने सहज अभिनय और सशक्त संवाद अदायगी से दर्शकों के मन पर अमिट छाप छोड़ी। गंभीर सामाजिक विषय हों या हास्य-व्यंग्य, उन्होंने जिस किरदार को निभाया, उसे जीवंत बना दिया। 'नाम फाउंडेशन' के माध्यम से सूखे से जूझ रहे किसान परिवारों की सेवा हो या सीमा पर जाकर जवानों का हौसला बढ़ाना, वे ख्याति के शिखर पर पहुंचकर भी अपनी मिट्टी से जुड़े रहे। जब भी उनसे मिलना हुआ, उनकी सरलता व स्पष्टवादिता ने सदैव प्रभावित किया। ईश्वर शोकाकुल परिजनों व प्रशंसकों को यह दु:ख सहने की शक्ति प्रदान करें और दिवंगत आत्मा को अपने श्रीचरणों में स्थान दें।

जब कांग्रेस के सत्ता के अहंकार ने देश पर आपातकाल थोपकर लोकतंत्र का गला घोंटने का प्रयास किया, तब लोकनायक निर्भीकता से करोड़ों देशवासियों की आवाज बनकर खड़े हुए। कारावास व यातनाएं भी उन्हें अपने संकल्प से विचलित नहीं कर सकीं और उनके 'सम्पूर्ण क्रांति' के उद्घोष के सामने तानाशाही इंदिरा गांधी की सरकार को झुकना पड़ा।

जयप्रकाश नारायण जी का जीवन दर्शन हर राष्ट्रप्रेमी के लिए प्रेरणा का अक्षय स्रोत है।

मुख्यमंत्री व प्रधानमंत्री के रूप में मोदी जी की 25 वर्षों की यात्रा जनकल्याण, गरीब कल्याण व भारत के गौरव की यात्रा है। देशभर के युवा इससे प्रेरणा लें, इसीलिए इसे 'सेवा ज्योति यात्रा' के रूप में मनाया जा रहा है। इस अवसर पर गुरुग्राम (हरियाणा) में आयोजित 'विकसित भारत संकल्प सभा : सेवा ज्योति यात्रा' में शामिल हुआ।

मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में देश ने गरीबी से मुक्ति की ओर कदम बढ़ाया, विज्ञान से लेकर विरासत तक हर क्षेत्र में परचम लहराया और एक स्वाभिमानी राष्ट्र के रूप में अपनी पहचान बनाई।

आइए, आज इस अवसर पर संकल्प लें कि मोदी जी ने 2047 के विकसित भारत का जो लक्ष्य देश के सामने रखा है, उसे पूरा करने तक न रुकेंगे, न थकेंगे और न पथ से डिगेंगे।

आज मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में भारत तेजी से बढ़ती अर्थव्यवस्था के साथ मैन्युफैक्चरिंग, डिजिटल पेमेंट, स्टार्टअप, सेमीकंडक्टर, रक्षा उत्पादन और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा जैसे क्षेत्रों में नई ऊंचाइयां छू रहा है।

युद्ध व अस्थिरता के इस दौर में भारत शांति व सौहार्द की एक महत्वपूर्ण वैश्विक आवाज बनकर उभरा है।

मोदी जी ने करोड़ों देशवासियों में आत्मविश्वास जगाकर ‘विकसित भारत’ का मंत्र दिया और 2047 तक हर क्षेत्र में भारत को अग्रणी बनाने का संकल्प दिलाया। उनके नेतृत्व में सेवा कार्यों का भागीदार बनना हम सभी के लिए सौभाग्य व गौरव की बात है।

मोदी जी ने मुख्यमंत्री के रूप में भूकंप से उजड़े कच्छ का पुनर्निर्माण कर उसे एक मिसाल बनाया, ज्योतिग्राम योजना से गांव-गांव तक 24 घंटे बिजली पहुंचाई, सौर ऊर्जा और वाइब्रेंट गुजरात के माध्यम से निवेश व उद्योग को नई दिशा दी तथा 8% से अधिक कृषि विकास दर हासिल कर गुजरात में सुशासन का एक ऐसा मॉडल खड़ा किया, जो आगे चलकर पूरे देश का आधार बना।

प्रधानमंत्री के रूप में इसी दृष्टि का विस्तार हुआ। अंतरिक्ष से समुद्र तक और वैश्विक मंचों से आंतरिक सुरक्षा तक भारत ने नई उपलब्धियां हासिल कीं।

जन-जन के जीवन में भी बड़ा बदलाव आया—25 करोड़ लोग गरीबी से बाहर निकले और करोड़ों परिवारों को पक्के मकान, ₹5 लाख तक का स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा कवर, उज्ज्वला गैस कनेक्शन और घर-घर नल से जल पहुंचा।

rawContent:
अथक परिश्रम, अद्भुत संकल्पशक्ति व राष्ट्र प्रथम को जीवन का लक्ष्य बनाने वाले यशस्वी प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी के सेवा और समर्पण के 25 वर्ष पूर्ण होने पर उन्हें हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ।

आज ही के दिन, 7 अक्टूबर 2001 को मोदी जी ने गुजरात के मुख्यमंत्री के रूप में शपथ ली। तब से लगातार मुख्यमंत्री और प्रधानमंत्री के रूप में उनकी सेवा, संघर्ष व समर्पण की यह यात्रा गरीबों का कल्याण, महिलाओं का सशक्तीकरण, युवाओं का उत्थान और हर वर्ग की समृद्धि का पर्याय बन गई है।

#25YearsOfSeva में मोदी जी ने जनकल्याणकारी नीतियों, उनके क्रियान्वयन, निर्णय की दृढ़ता, पारदर्शिता व परिणाम की गारंटी से शासन की परिभाषा ही बदल दी और 'पॉलिटिक्स ऑफ परफॉर्मेंस' का आदर्श स्थापित किया।

Yesterday, the nation's young came out in Delhi to peacefully protest. They came with love in their hearts, not hatred or anger. They were beaten, both by cops and BJP goons. 

This is not the India we want.

Tomorrow, we will march to the Supreme Court as Indians, united beyond party, gender, caste, community and state. 

Youth, all opposition parties, civil society groups, all those who believe in democracy and stand by the Constitution of India, will walk with us.

We will submit a memorandum to the Chief Justice on behalf of the nation, demanding an end to vote chori, halting of SIR and the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar.

Narendra Modi, Amit Shah, Ajit Doval and Mohan Bhagwat cannot silence India's voice. These cowards cannot intimidate us. They will have to step aside.

We will march together, with love, brotherhood and patriotism.

Daro mat. 

Tomorrow, all of India will march to the Supreme Court. 

कल दिल्ली में देश का युवा शांतिपूर्ण विरोध के लिए सड़कों पर उतरा। उनके दिलों में नफ़रत या गुस्सा नहीं, मोहब्बत थी। लेकिन उन्हें पुलिस और BJP के गुंडों, दोनों ने पीटा।

ऐसा भारत हम नहीं चाहते।

कल, सोमवार 12 अक्टूबर को, हम भारतीय होने के नाते सुप्रीम कोर्ट तक मार्च करेंगे। पार्टी, महिला-पुरुष, जाति, समुदाय और राज्य की हर दीवार से ऊपर उठकर, हम सब एक साथ चलेंगे।

देश का युवा, तमाम विपक्षी दल, सिविल सोसाइटी और लोकतंत्र में विश्वास रखने वाले, भारत के संविधान के साथ खड़े सभी लोग हमारे साथ चलेंगे।

हम देश की ओर से मुख्य न्यायाधीश को एक ज्ञापन सौंपेंगे। हमारी माँग है - वोट चोरी बंद हो, SIR पर रोक लगे और ज्ञानेश कुमार इस्तीफ़ा दें।

नरेंद्र मोदी, अमित शाह, अजित डोभाल और मोहन भागवत भारत की आवाज़ को दबा नहीं सकते। ये कायर हमें डरा नहीं सकते। इन्हें पीछे हटना ही होगा।
हम सब साथ चलेंगे - मोहब्बत, भाईचारे और देशभक्ति के साथ।

डरो मत।

I’ve been fighting Narendra Modi and the RSS for over a decade now. I understand them like you would understand your opponent - inside out, like the back of my hand.

The core characteristic of these people is cowardice.

Narendra Modi, Amit Shah, Mohan Bhagwat, Gyanesh Kumar and Ajit Doval, the villains of this story, are slowly finding the space closing around them. We are closing that space. 

Mr. Modi, do whatever you want. Call out all the police: 10,000, 20,000, 50,000, whatever you want.

Arrest all the leaders. Arrest all the young people. Arrest us all. 

We are surrounding you, and we are not going to back down. Mark my words: we already have the information we need.

We are going to defend our Constitution. We are going to protect the voice of the Indian people. And we are going to ensure that what was done to India over the last 10-15 years will never, ever be done again.

Youth of India, I am proud of you. Keep protesting. We are standing with you.

We are going to ensure that this regime and the people who have attacked our Constitution are defeated.

मैं नरेंद्र मोदी, RSS और इनसे जुड़े लोगों के ख़िलाफ़ एक दशक से भी ज़्यादा समय से लड़ रहा हूँ। मैं अपने विरोधियों को उतनी अच्छी तरह समझता हूँ, जितना कोई भी अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी को समझता है। मैं इन्हें अंदर तक जानता हूँ, इनकी हर चाल से वाक़िफ़ हूँ।

इन लोगों की सबसे बड़ी पहचान है - कायरता।

नरेंद्र मोदी, अमित शाह, मोहन भागवत, ज्ञानेश कुमार, अजीत डोभाल - इस कहानी के खलनायक - अब धीरे-धीरे घिरते जा रहे हैं। इनके चारों तरफ़ से दायरा सिमट रहा है।

जो करना है, कर लीजिए। जितनी पुलिस बुलानी है, बुला लीजिए - 10 हज़ार, 20 हज़ार, 50 हज़ार, जितनी चाहें बुला लीजिए।

सारे नेताओं को गिरफ़्तार कर लीजिए। सारे युवाओं को गिरफ़्तार कर लीजिए। हम सबको गिरफ़्तार कर लीजिए। 

घबराइये मत - हम आपको चारों तरफ़ से घेर रहे हैं, और हम पीछे हटने वाले नहीं हैं।
मेरी बात याद रखिए - हमें जो जानकारी चाहिए, वह हमारे पास पहले से है।

हम अपने संविधान की रक्षा करेंगे। हम हिंदुस्तान की जनता की आवाज़ की हिफ़ाज़त करेंगे। और हम यह सुनिश्चित करेंगे कि पिछले 10-15 सालों में हिंदुस्तान के साथ जो हुआ है, वह दोबारा कभी, किसी भी सूरत में न हो।

जंतर-मंतर पर सैकड़ों लोग हिरासत में लिए गए। महिला प्रदर्शनकारियों ने आरोप लगाया कि पुरुष पुलिसकर्मियों ने उनके साथ बदसलूकी की। महिला पत्रकारों के कैमरे छीने गए, उन्हें घसीटा गया। एक पत्रकार की शिकायत पर FIR तक दर्ज नहीं हुई।

कुछ हफ्तों पहले शाहीन और नफ़ीसा ने साकेत थाने के अंदर अपने साथ हुई हिंसा और बदसलूकी की आपबीती सुनाई है। सोचिए, थाने के अंदर - वो जगह जहां महिलाएं शिकायत लेकर जाती हैं।

जिन पर महिलाओं की रक्षा की ज़िम्मेदारी है, वही आज उनके लिए ख़तरा बन रहे हैं। और दिल्ली पुलिस किसके अधीन है - यह पूरा देश जानता है।

साकेत थाने का पूरा CCTV फुटेज सार्वजनिक किया जाए। दोषी पुलिसकर्मियों पर तुरंत कार्रवाई हो। शाहीन, नफ़ीसा और जिनके साथ भी दिल्ली पुलिस ने हिंसा और बदतमीज़ी की है उनको न्याय मिले।

अमित शाह जी - आप और आपकी पुलिस महिलाओं से डरती क्यों है?

Yesterday, the nation's young came out in Delhi to peacefully protest. They came with love in their hearts, not hatred or anger. They were beaten, both by cops and BJP goons. 

This is not the India we want.

Tomorrow, we will march to the Supreme Court as Indians, united beyond party, gender, caste, community and state. 

Youth, all opposition parties, civil society groups, all those who believe in democracy and stand by the Constitution of India, will walk with us.

We will submit a memorandum to the Chief Justice on behalf of the nation, demanding an end to vote chori, halting of SIR and the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar.

Narendra Modi, Amit Shah, Ajit Doval and Mohan Bhagwat cannot silence India's voice. These cowards cannot intimidate us. They will have to step aside.

We will march together, with love, brotherhood and patriotism.

Daro mat. 

Tomorrow, all of India will march to the Supreme Court. 

कल दिल्ली में देश का युवा शांतिपूर्ण विरोध के लिए सड़कों पर उतरा। उनके दिलों में नफ़रत या गुस्सा नहीं, मोहब्बत थी। लेकिन उन्हें पुलिस और BJP के गुंडों, दोनों ने पीटा।

ऐसा भारत हम नहीं चाहते।

कल, सोमवार 12 अक्टूबर को, हम भारतीय होने के नाते सुप्रीम कोर्ट तक मार्च करेंगे। पार्टी, महिला-पुरुष, जाति, समुदाय और राज्य की हर दीवार से ऊपर उठकर, हम सब एक साथ चलेंगे।

देश का युवा, तमाम विपक्षी दल, सिविल सोसाइटी और लोकतंत्र में विश्वास रखने वाले, भारत के संविधान के साथ खड़े सभी लोग हमारे साथ चलेंगे।

नरेंद्र मोदी, अमित शाह, अजित डोभाल और मोहन भागवत भारत की आवाज़ को दबा नहीं सकते। ये कायर हमें डरा नहीं सकते। इन्हें पीछे हटना ही होगा।
हम सब साथ चलेंगे - मोहब्बत, भाईचारे और देशभक्ति के साथ।

Every time India takes a bold step forward, the same voices crawl out to predict doom.

The script never changes. ONLY the topic does.

• Pokhran: Despite warnings of sanctions and isolation, India strengthened its strategic standing.
• Narmada to Ekta Nagar: A once-contested project is now associated with water access, connectivity and tourism.
• Vaccines & semiconductors: From indigenous vaccine development to 12 approved semiconductor projects, India is building domestic capabilities.
• Aadhaar & UPI: Once criticised over privacy and security, they have become key pillars of India’s digital economy.
• Electoral roll revision: Verification can help maintain accurate voter lists, provided transparency and due process are upheld.

देश में विभाजन और अराजकता का दुष्प्रचार किया जा रहा है। एक अभियान चलाया जा रहा है, क्योंकि भारत एक बहुत प्रभावी स्थिति में उभरकर आगे आ रहा है और बहुत-सी शक्तियों को यह अच्छा नहीं लग रहा होगा।

एक किलोमीटर के दायरे में बैरिकेडिंग हो गई, तो इन्हें आपातकाल याद आ गया। 

आज की पीढ़ी को याद दिलाना चाहिए कि आपातकाल क्या था। आज यहाँ बैठकर ये लोग PM मोदी के बारे में अनाप-शनाप बोलते हैं। आपातकाल में एक नियम था, Defence of India Rules (DIR)। अगर आप किसी सार्वजनिक स्थान पर सिर्फ इतना बोल देते कि इंदिरा गांधी को हटाना है, तो आप जेल में होते और जमानत के लिए आवेदन भी नहीं कर सकते थे।

कोर्ट में जब वकील के द्वारा पूछा गया कि अगर पुलिस किसी को गोली मारती है, तो क्या हम देखते रहें, तो कहा गया था, “हाँ, देखते रहो।”

मानवाधिकार खत्म कर दिए गए थे, हमारे मूल अधिकार खत्म कर दिए गए थे और पूरा विपक्ष जेल में था।

राई और पहाड़ की तुलना करने का प्रयास लोकतंत्र का मजाक उड़ाना है। जो लोग लोकतंत्र को भीड़तंत्र में बदलकर अराजकता उत्पन्न करना चाहते हैं, उनके मंसूबे सबको पता होने चाहिए। इसलिए जब आप आपातकाल से तुलना करते हैं, तो आप आपातकाल में यातनाएँ सहने वालों के कष्ट का मजाक बना रहे हैं।

What lies at the heart of Indian civilisation?

In the First Episode Of 'Indology', Author and historian Hindol Sengupta explores India’s civilisational memory, the central role of the Goddess and the concept of the feminine divine in Indian traditions.

He examines how politics and secularism have shaped India’s understanding of its own history, why the country needs to rediscover its living traditions, and how ideas of womanhood, cultural ethos and national identity intersect.

Sengupta also discusses the Vande Bharat debate, historical consciousness and the challenges India may face in the coming decade.

Thirteen students fell ill after allegedly being served potato curry containing a lizard at a school hostel in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The children, studying in Classes 6 to 9, complained of vomiting and diarrhoea after eating the food and were taken to the city's Jaiprakash (JP) Hospital for treatment.

All 13 children are currently reported to be in stable condition, according to school authorities and doctors.

The incident took place at the Shramodaya Vidyalaya school's hostel in the Ratibad area, raising questions over food safety and hygiene standards in the institution's canteen.

Parents of the affected students alleged that the school or hostel management did not inform them promptly about their children's condition. They said they learnt about the incident through the school's group and rushed to JP Hospital.

IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe has been appointed secretary of a high-level inquiry commission set up to investigate alleged paper leaks in Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) examinations.

The commission will be headed by former judge Dilip Bhosale, with the inquiry expected to be completed within two months, Maharashtra Public Works Minister Shivendrasinhraje Bhosale announced.

The government has also agreed to withdraw cases registered against the protesting students and double the number of posts in the 2027 Group C recruitment examination.

rawContent:
The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has seized 74,612.11 kg of edible oil worth ₹1.28 crore during a special inspection drive across Pune division ahead of the festive season.

The drive covered 25 establishments across Pune, Sangli, Solapur, Satara and Kolhapur on October 9. Officials flagged suspected quality and safety concerns, improper labelling and other alleged violations.

In Pune, seizures included 358.4 kg of groundnut oil from Garden Vadapav Centre and 3,176.8 kg of edible oil from Praj Traders at Gultekadi’s Market Yard. Pune district accounted for 34,481.1 kg of the total seizure, valued at approximately ₹58.90 lakh.

The FDA said samples of the seized oil would be sent for laboratory analysis, with further legal action to follow after the reports are received.

Saudi Arabia's General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) confirmed that King Fahd International Airport, located in the kingdom's Eastern Province, was targeted on Sunday evening, October 11. The authority said inspections were underway but did not immediately disclose the extent of the damage or whether there were casualties.

Punjab Police ASI Iqbal Singh, 55, was killed in a targeted attack by two motorcycle-borne assailants while returning home after duty in Tarn Taran on Sunday evening. Singh, who was posted with the Counter Intelligence wing in Makhu, was travelling on his motorcycle when the attackers intercepted him near a patwar khana on the Naushera Pannuan–Lohka Road around 7:30 pm. He died at the scene, and the assailants fled.

Police are investigating a possible link to the murder of Singh’s nephew, Ajmeet Singh, who was killed in a similar attack on September 11. In that case, an accused was injured in a police encounter and later arrested. Investigators are examining CCTV footage and pursuing leads to identify the attackers and establish the motive. A social media post reportedly claiming responsibility for the killing has not been independently verified.

The killing has raised fresh concerns about the safety of police personnel in Punjab, with the investigation ongoing.

CNN-News18 has exclusively accessed the FIR in the sexual misconduct case involving Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) professor and Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam. The FIR cites findings of the university’s Internal Committee, which alleged a recurring pattern of inappropriate personal interactions, sexually suggestive conduct and unwelcome physical contact with female students. The committee said the alleged conduct created an “intimidating, offensive, and hostile learning environment”. The FIR states that a prima facie offence is made out under Sections 75/75(1)(i)/75(1)(iv)/79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The university has dismissed Akoijam following sexual harassment complaints reportedly filed by 11 women students.

Akoijam has challenged the university’s handling of the inquiry, alleging procedural lapses and disputing Vice-Chancellor Santishree Dhulipudi Pandit’s claims about defence witnesses and communications. He said he submitted a written response on May 31 and his deposition on July 16, adding that his witnesses gave their depositions on August 14, 2026. He also disputed the reported claim that around 300 emails were sent to him, saying he received and responded to 43. Calling the proceedings a “witchhunt”, he criticised the media coverage as a “media trial” and rejected references to “sex for grades”, arguing that the allegation was not part of the complaint. He said his legal team would pursue the matter.

#AngomchaBimolAkoijam #JNU

The Motor Vehicles Department is expected to initiate proceedings to revoke Suhail’s driving licence, while BMW officials will examine the car for its speed and possible technical defects.

India has condemned attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz region after Nicaragua-flagged tanker MT Petro Dolphin, carrying 11 Indian seafarers, was hit by a drone at Sohar Anchorage in Oman on October 11. Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said nine crew members were rescued, while two remain missing. "While nine of our Indian crew members have been successfully rescued and are safe, two Indian nationals currently remain missing," Sonowal said on X. Search-and-rescue operations are underway, with the Indian Embassy in Muscat coordinating with authorities.

The latest attack follows a projectile strike on Marshall Islands-flagged tanker M/T Valthera in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, which triggered a fire. All 11 Indian crew members aboard were reported safe. The Ministry of External Affairs condemned the repeated attacks, calling for immediate de-escalation and a resolution through dialogue and diplomacy. "Attacks on commercial vessels, seafarers and civilian infrastructure must cease," the Ministry said, stressing the need to uphold freedom of navigation and the safe flow of maritime commerce.

The Supreme Court has clarified that it has neither approved, nor disapproved the alleged changes to the (declaration in) From-6 in its judgement that held the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) constitutionally valid.

Justice Joymalya Bagchi verbally reiterated what the Chief Justice of India (CJI) had said in an earlier hearing of a separate plea seeking suspension of CEC Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in functioning of ECI, that it had not approved any alleged changes to Form 6. 

“What the CJI had said was that we had neither approved nor disapproved any such change to Form 6 in our judgement”, Justice Bagchi said to Advocate Narendra Mishra who has challenged CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s alleged unilateral decisions in the functioning of the ECI on behalf of petitioner Priya Mishra.

rawContent:
A plea has been mentioned before the Supreme Court seeking action against certain hooligans who are allegedly attacking protesters and lawyers allegedly without facing any police action, in the ongoing protests in New Delhi. The plea also raised concerns over videos purportedly showing such persons flaunting their acts of violence and facing no legal consequences. 

Senior Advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan who mentioned the plea urged the Court to intervene and to stop such hooligans. 

“Private hooligans are not being stopped. They are making videos and proudly proclaiming what they have done. I am shocked. I’ve never seen a senior advocated being dragged on the streets. At some point, the Bench will have to come to the rescue of the Bar and young children”, the senior lawyer said. 

Initially, the Court said the Supreme Court should not become a political battleground. However, after counsel clarified that the matter was a fresh plea seeking action against alleged hooligans, the Court agreed to list it tomorrow along with the other protest-related matters.

rawContent: Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi (@MohanMOdisha) posts on X: "The credibility of a democracy rests on free and fair elections and the protection of every eligible citizen’s right to vote. Clean and accurate electoral rolls are fundamental to this trust. Duplicate entries, outdated records and the names of deceased persons remaining on voter lists can compromise their accuracy. Ensuring reliable electoral rolls is, therefore, not merely an administrative necessity, but essential to safeguarding electoral integrity and strengthening public confidence in democracy. The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is vital to ensuring that electoral rolls accurately reflect eligible voters. It helps identify discrepancies, eliminate duplicate entries, update records following deaths or changes in residence, and ensure that eligible voters are not left out. Equally, the process must protect every legitimate voter from wrongful exclusion. These are not minor administrative details; they go to the heart of electoral fairness, equal representation and the sanctity of every vote. SIR is a necessary and constructive exercise to uphold the integrity of our electoral system. Its effective implementation, with fairness and due diligence, will help ensure that electoral records remain reliable and that the democratic process commands the confidence it deserves."

STORY | Not my domain: CJI on Delhi protests, curbs

"Ye mera mudda nahin hai. (This matter doesn't pertain to my domain," Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant said on Monday, when asked about protests against the CEC in Delhi over the past few days and the associated restrictions.

The CJI was interacting with reporters on the sidelines of an event to commemorate the 33rd anniversary of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) at Vigyan Bhawan here.

The last few days have seen protests against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar in different parts of Delhi. Over the weekend, the capital turned into a fortress, with massive deployment of security personnel, closure of 45 metro stations, and intensive checks at the city's border points.

Thousands of protesters, including Cockroach Janta Party leaders and former chief ministers, were detained.

The CJI, when asked about these protests and the restrictions on movement, said the matter was related to law and order.

"Ye mera mudda nahin hai," he said.

rawContent:
1. This is the season for looking at Narendra Modi’s 25 years in power, & beyond. His followers are celebrating. His Cabinet has passed a resolution praising him. Critics are dissecting his quarter century in public life, not with a scalpel but with a scythe. But the Modi-BJP story is still the most significant. It just isn’t as dominant as before. Multiple headwinds create the turbulence Modi is battling as he steps into his 26th year in public office. #NationalInterest
 
2. This has brought the so far all-conquering, 3-point Modi proposition under the greatest pressure since 2014: Hard, Hinduised nationalism; ever-expanding welfare, distributed efficiently, with minimal leakage; & visible construction of physical infrastructure. All of this without a significant overhang of corruption.
 
3. The Modi proposition survives. It’s just that several factors have now emerged. We aren’t just talking about the rebellion of an irreverential, ageist, educated, & mostly not-impoverished Gen-Z. In isolation, each of these factors may look small. But they become formidable when the big picture comes together. As the great management guru late CK Prahalad used to say, ‘weak signals add up to a big change’. Is this what Modi is confronted with now? 
 
4. From dramatic damage to the credibility of the EC, inflation, & small allies speaking out to Rahul Gandhi getting prominent space on TV channels & Hindi newspapers — including the ones ‘most trusted’ by the establishment — and a global situation for India not seen in decades, Modi is faced with the Shakespearean ‘battalions of sorrows’.
 
5. The larger issues, however, are rooted in the 3 most fundamental factors that have made India cohesive & stronger over the decades: Trust in the Constitution & the belief that nobody can take it away; fairness of the top judiciary; & independence of the EC. All 3 are under strain now.
 
6. These are the challenges Modi needs to address as he steps into his 26th unbroken year in public office. If he doesn’t, or fails to do so, CK Prahalad’s small signals theory shows that a dramatic crisis awaits Modi in the two and a half years until the summer of 2029.

Last evening, signed off as 🇧🇩 High Commissioner to India.
Ended an eighteen month stint (April '25 - Oct '26), marked with times/episodes like hardly ever before (as most noted). Such were times that would fit into an examination of '#diplomacy in crisis' (without marked conflict). Yet, ...
It's mostly a solitary walk. On most occasions, 'briefs' or (previous) precedents would hardly suffice/suggest.
My limited experience merely asked me to keep walking regardless of what naysayers may say and populate the space, to touch #people and their mindscape. Just no grand scheme. Looking back, "there's no dull day", as @CSDR_India | @IndiasWorld_mag headlined (May '26).
This morning, feels like, I survived many intense episodes when I risked being mis-understood. For me as a diplomat, it's testing endurance | patience | composure yet being able to ask/plea all to hold on the shared space for 🇧🇩 🇮🇳 ordinary people, in shared interests.
Yes, its easier said than done. But, irrespective of views one is sovereign to, must pledge to, given the shared agro-ecology we belong to, forever tied to.
I thank scores of friends who quietly lend their shoulders (or may be, believed in my 'two cents'). 
@MEAIndia @bdhc_delhi

rawContent:
1. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio delivered a speech from the birthplace of democracy. In Athens, he advocated for Trump’s policies, made the case for America First, urged Europe to awaken from slumber & attacked Iran’s ‘radical mullahs’. #CutTheClutter looks at the speech’s significance, its implications, & explains why it was a 2028 campaign speech disguised as statecraft.
 
2. Rubio’s central message to Europe was unmistakable. The West, he warned, must decide whether it intends to retain its place at the head of the world or resign itself to “servitude, atrophy and decline”. The other standout argument was that power is not simply about possessing capabilities. It is about convincing others that you are willing to use them. This applies to, for example, military force, trade leverage & tariffs.
 
3. There was also a defence of Trump’s transactional foreign policy. Rubio invoked Greenland, arguing that confrontation had eventually produced a settlement in which the US, Denmark & Greenland all emerged with gains. Rubio attacked Iran’s “radical mullahs”, portraying their ideology as one that glorifies death & martyrdom. He contrasted this with the Western ideal of heroes willing to die for a cause but not worshipping death itself.
 
4. Rubio’s speech was carefully constructed: The ancient setting, the references to Greek democracy & Rome, the invocation of Christianity, the language of duty & heroism. And that’s where 2028 enters the picture. Rubio has been a Republican presidential contender, & this certainly seemed to be a 2028 campaign speech wrapped in the very gentle language of diplomacy.
 
5. What does his speech mean for India?
·        Trumpism won’t disappear after Trump. If Republicans return, a Rubio- or Vance-led govt could preserve much of this agenda, albeit in a different tone. Even a Democratic administration may retain parts of these policies.
·        US focus on supply chains, re-industrialisation, military strength, tech dominance, AI, strategic autonomy, & critical minerals are not just Trump’s passing fancy, US policy will be built around them. India can live with this as long as it is seen an ally, friend or useful.
·        CNP or comprehensive national power. India needs to look at this. CNP is not just military strength, it’s also size of the economy, tech capability, industrial depth, critical-mineral security & quality of human resources.

rawContent:
1. Post-Independence India was born in the turmoil of Partition, & war over Kashmir. Some armed conflict, external or internal, has bedevilled India in every decade since. But, who first justified India going to war? And what was his moral argument? Then there’s the eternal question: Is India a soft state, chronically suffering from that Gandhian ‘offer the other cheek’ brainwash? Or, is it among the hardest post-colonial democracies, only cynically invoking the Gandhian pretence when convenient? #NationalInterest
 
2. Mahatma Gandhi’s birth anniversary gave us a moment to examine a widespread belief that cuts across party lines — India is a soft state, & has conceded too much to the enemies outside & within; if only we had followed Sardar Patel, Netaji & Savarkar. The overwhelming Gandhian indoctrination, the argument goes, was worsened by Nehru’s pacifist internationalism. This thrived under most govts that followed. It continues even now.
 
3. But facts & history point to the contrary. Given its economic & military limitations, India has mostly succeeded in punching above its weight. Modern India might have been conjured up in Gandhi’s image. But it was never a Gandhian state. Founders of the Republic, be it Nehru or Patel, nursed zero such notions. And yes, you probably guessed right. It was Gandhi who blessed India’s first war.
 
4. It’s among the little-known moments in our history when Gandhi endorsed violence & war. And the pattern continued. For every criticism thrown at Nehru for taking Kashmir to the UN, the fact is, he fought to enhance India’s interests militarily. There were many failures in his nearly 17 years as PM, but India was by no means a soft state. It fought Pakistan, took on China if unsuccessfully, swept aside the Nizam/Razakar challenge in Hyderabad, & liberated Goa. Today’s AFSPA was brought in by the supposedly peacenik Nehru.
 
5. Finally, the Modi years. The hard element came to the fore with the doctrine of retaliation. The surgical strikes, Balakot & Op Sindoor established a new normal. The only area Modi erred in was not spending enough on defence in his first 11 years, & not giving the defence budget a top-up for the additional cost of OROP.
 
6. And, here’s something counterintuitive. Modi has been mocked with cries of ‘Narender-surrender’ for ceasing hostilities during Op Sindoor. Or, not escalating after the one set of air exchanges post Balakot. I’d call each also an expression of strength, not weakness. Stepping off the escalation ladder, when you have enough to show for success, is also an assertion of a hard state. At least on this aspect, Gandhi would be happy with the state of the nation.

rawContent:
1. Israel has been at war for 3 years, but has shown economic resilience. Its defence exports have surged by 130% between 2020 & 2025, and it’s among the leading exporters of high-tech goods & services. #CutTheClutter looks at factors behind Israel’s unusual war economy & why it has shown financial resilience.
 
2. The Bank of Israel estimates the cumulative economic hit between 2023 & 2026 was about NIS 177bn — roughly $60bn, or around 8.6% of GDP. Growth fell to about 2% in 2023 & just 1% in 2024. But it recovered to 2.9% in 2025. Now, the Bank of Israel expects around 4% growth in 2026, while the OECD puts it at 3.7%.
 
3. How? Well, Israel has many strengths. It has a high-tech economy & it is deeply integrated with the global economy — able to raise capital, invest, manufacture & sell abroad. Then there is US backing & the defence industry. But here’s something counterintuitive — in 2025, Israel’s total exports were $169bn, but defence exports were $19.2bn or just about 12%.
 
4. What’s important to understand is Israel isn’t a conventional manufacturing economy; 58% of its exports are high-tech. It doesn’t make the big machines (cars, buses, ships, aircraft), it makes much of the sophisticated tech that goes inside them. Also, a lot of what Israel produces & sells is actually affected positively by war.
 
5. Israel gets attacked by drones or missiles, it develops tech to counter them, other countries facing similar threats see those systems working, they start buying them. Look at 2025 data, missiles, rockets & air-defence systems accounted for 29% of Israeli defence exports. Observation & optronics accounted for another 22%.
 
6. Now, how has India contributed to Israel’s growing defence exports, and what’s the change in it post-Abraham Accords?

quotedTweet.rawContent:
Lt Gen J. F. R. Jacob was more than one of India’s greatest military strategists. He was a proud Indian Jew whose life showed what true belonging looks like.

Born into Kolkata’s Baghdadi Jewish community, Jacob served India with distinction from the jungles of Burma to the liberation of Bangladesh in 1971. As Chief of Staff of Eastern Command, he helped shape the campaign that brought the war to a decisive end. On 16 December 1971, he flew to Dhaka and helped secure the surrender of Pakistan’s Eastern Command.

Around 90,000 Pakistani personnel laid down their arms. Bangladesh was born.

Jacob later served as Governor of Punjab and Goa, and as Administrator of Chandigarh. He never had to choose between his Jewish identity and his Indian patriotism. India allowed him to be entirely both.

His story is one of courage, service and the enduring bond between India and the Jewish people.

Lt Gen J. F. R. Jacob: a great Indian, a proud Jew, and a hero whose legacy still speaks.  Read his full story below - link in first message

quotedTweet.rawContent: I'm often asked how much of the current U.S. posture in Asia is a function of Donald Trump, how much transcends him, and therefore how much of the current policy dispensation is likely to endure after he leaves office. भारतीय ज्ञान परंपरा में किसी कार्य की सिद्धि का एक सरल सूत्र है इच्छति, जानाति करोति । यानी पहले इच्छा जागती है, फिर ज्ञान उसे दिशा देता है और अंत में कर्म उसे परिणाम तक पहुंचाता है। ये तीन शक्तियां इच्छाशक्ति, ज्ञानशक्ति और क्रियाशक्ति के रूप में लक्ष्मी, सरस्वती और काली से जुड़ती है। लेकिन, जीवन में इनके साथ परिस्थितियों को संभालने की क्षमता भी जरूरी है। यही दुर्गा के रूप में शक्ति का चौथा आयाम सामने लाती है।

हर परिवर्तन की शुरुआत इच्छा से होती है कुछ नया सीखने, लक्ष्य पाने या जीवन को सार्थक बनाने की आकांक्षा ही आगे बढ़ने की प्रेरणा देती है । लक्ष्मी का व्यापक स्वरूप केवल धन-संपत्ति तक सीमित नहीं है । वह लक्ष्यबोध और संकल्प की प्रतीक भी हैं। स्पष्ट लक्ष्य के बिना प्रतिभा दिशाहीन हो सकती है । इच्छा को दिशा देने के लिए ज्ञान आवश्यक है। सरस्वती ज्ञान,
विवेक, मेधा, वाणी और सृजनशीलता की शक्ति हैं। ज्ञान केवल सूचनाएं जुटाना नहीं, उन्हें विचार, निर्णय और आचरण का हिस्सा बनाना है।

आज आर्टिफिशल इंटेलिजेंस सूचनाएं तुरंत उपलब्ध करा सकती है. लेकिन विवेक और सही दिशा का महत्व बना हुआ है। शिक्षा का उद्देश्य ऐसी मेधा विकसित करना है, जो सत्य-असत्य में अंतर कर सके और ज्ञान को लोकमंगल से जोड़ सके।

ज्ञान तभी सार्थक है, जब वह कर्म में उतरे। महाकाली केवल विनाश की प्रतीक नहीं, बल्कि जड़ता, भय, आलस्य और संदेह को तोड़कर आगे बढ़ने की निर्णायक शक्ति हैं। कठिनाइयों के बावजूद प्रयास करना क्रियाशक्ति का परिचय है। जीवना इच्छा, ज्ञान और कर्म का सीधा-सादा क्रम नहीं है। परिवार, कार्यक्षेत्र, संबंधों और व्यक्तिगत आकांक्षाओं के बीच संतुलन नाना पड़ता है। दुर्गा इन शक्तियों के समन्वय और परिस्थिति के अनुरूप उचित निर्णय लेने का सामर्थ्य प्रदान करती हैं। शारदीय नवरात्रि का संदेश है कि देवी की आराधना भीतर के जागरण का माध्यम बने इच्छा को संकल्प, ज्ञान को दिशा और कर्म को साधना बनाकर जीवन में संतुलन स्थापित करें। यही महाशक्ति की चतुमूर्ति का जीवन सूत्र

Forget the rest of the world; even a look at India's history reveals how this nation humbled everyone from the Mughals and the Portuguese to the British, who once arrogantly claimed that the sun never sets on their empire. Do you, the current rulers, really think the people here won't bring you down to earth too? As a government, you are expected to show maturity; if you lack it, then learn it and internalize it.

rawContent:
“No nation can be grateful at the cost of its liberty” - these are the words of Bharat Ratna Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar. He made this profound statement while presenting the draft of the Indian Constitution in November 1949. The nation's values of freedom and expression must never be jeopardized for the sake of blind devotion to a leader or to indulge their eccentric behavior.

This statement needs to be reiterated today because the duo of Modi and Shah harbors an extreme authoritarian mindset. Leveraging this authoritarianism, they captured the country's institutions to seize power. Power that is now being wielded solely to serve the interests of a handful of industrialists. If protesters are to be crushed and arrested simply for opposing this arrogant abuse of power or demonstrating against it, then this unchecked tyranny must be uprooted from the country, from the grassroots to the highest levels.

Are protests forbidden in this country? Are questions not to be asked? Who are you to snatch away the right to protest? Protests have been ongoing in Delhi since October 3rd, demanding the resignation of the corrupt Chief Election Commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar. Using the Delhi Police as an instrument, the government not only crushed protesters but also harassed the female journalists covering the agitation.

Fearing protests in Delhi today, you have shut down metro services, blocked roads, suspended internet and bus services, and are even detaining protesters directly from flights. What kind of approach is this? Young men and women in their twenties and thirties across the country are restless; they cannot see a future for themselves. That is why they are taking to the streets to protest peacefully, and you are trying to crush them? With what face will Modi go around the world claiming that our country is democratic? Is this democracy?

I don’t understand this immense love for Gyanesh Kumar. Is it because Gyanesh Kumar, and the election officials before him, are your instruments for seizing power? The Election Commission is an autonomous body. What’s wrong in demanding the resignation of its chief if he has messed up things? What’s wrong with wanting an honest and transparent electoral system? My right to vote is being taken away, I am unable to track where and to whom my vote is going. Don’t I have the right to express my anger when my vote is getting insulted this way? Or is it that the two leaders at the top fear that if Gyanesh Kumar is forced to resign and reveals the masterminds behind the vote theft, the entire charade of their power will be exposed?

Under Articles 19(1)(a) and (b) of the Indian Constitution, citizens have the full right to stage peaceful protests. Why do you wish to crush this right? Just yesterday, the Honorable Supreme Court asked, "Why use a sledgehammer to swat a fly?" Typically, the police department in Maharashtra detains protesters and then releases them, ensuring that citizens' constitutional rights remain intact in the process. But in Delhi, female journalists covering the protest have complained of harassment by the police after being detained. If those covering the protest are being harassed, what guarantee is there that the protesters themselves will be treated properly?

It appears that the anger over the youth of this country forcing you to yield and compelling Dharmendra Pradhan to resign has not yet subsided. During the Anna Hazare agitation, Modi and Shah allowed protests to take place in Gujarat because it served their interests; yet, while in power in that very state, they crushed numerous protests against their own government. In short, their hypocrisy and double standards are glaringly obvious.

आज आपण सत्तेत आहोत म्हणजे अनंत काळापर्यंत असू ही अपेक्षा बाळगू नका. तुम्ही काही सत्तेचा अमरपट्टा घेऊन जन्माला आलेले नाही आहात. जेव्हा सत्तेतून एखादा हुकूमशाही मानसिकतेचा सत्ताधारी जातो त्यानंतर त्याची जनताच कशी पळताभुई करतात याची जगभरातील उदाहरणं आठवा. जगभरातील सोडा भारताचा इतिहास वाचलात तरी कळेल जिथे मुघलांपासून, पोर्तुगीजांपासून ते आमच्या साम्रज्यावरचा सूर्य मावळत नाही असा माज करणाऱ्या ब्रिटिशांचा जिथे या देशाने माज उतरवला, तिथे स्वकीयांचा माज इथली जनता उतरवणार नाही, असं वाटतंय का तुम्हा सत्ताधाऱ्यांना ? सरकार म्हणून तुमच्याकडून मॅच्युरिटीची अपेक्षा आहे, ती नसेलच तर शिकून घ्या, आत्मसात करा. 

आंदोलन करणाऱ्या प्रत्येकाला आंदोलन करण्याचा अधिकार आहे, आणि तो अबाधितच राहिला पाहिजे हे निश्चित ! 

राज ठाकरे ।

"No nation can be grateful at the cost of its liberty" हे उद्गार आहेत, भारतरत्न डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर यांचे. नोव्हेंबर १९४९ ला भारतीय राज्यघटनेचा मसुदा सादर करताना त्यांनी हे अतिशय महत्वाचे उद्गार काढले होते. 
एखाद्या नेत्याच्या आंधळ्या भक्तीसाठी किंवा त्याच्या तऱ्हेवाईक वागण्याला खतपाणी घालण्यासाठी या देशाची स्वातंत्र्य, अभिव्यक्ती ही मूल्य अजिबात पणाला लागता कामा नयेत. 

हे वाक्य आज पुन्हा म्हणावं लागतंय. कारण मोदी आणि शाह या जोडीच्या मनात आणि डोक्यात अत्यंत पराकोटीची हुकूमशाही बसली आहे . या हुकूमशाहीच्या जोरावर या जोडीने  देशातील सगळ्या यंत्रणांना काबीज करून जी सत्ता मिळवली.  आणि जी सत्ता फक्त मूठभर उद्योगपतींच्या हितासाठी राबवली जात आहे. सत्तेच्या या मस्तीला विरोध केला, त्याच्या विरोधात निदर्शनं केली म्हणून, जर आंदोलकांना चिरडलं जाणार असेल आणि त्यांना अटक केली जाणार असेल तर, त्यांच्या या बेबंदशाहीला या देशातून खालपासून वरपर्यंत उखडूनच काढलं पाहिजे ! 

या देशांत आंदोलनं करायचीच नाहीत? तुम्हाला प्रश्न विचारायचेच नाहीत ? आंदोलन करणं हा अधिकार हिरावून घेणारे तुम्ही कोण ? भ्रष्ट मुख्य निवडणूक आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार यांच्या राजीनाम्याची मागणी घेऊन ३ ऑक्टोबरपासून दिल्लीत आंदोलनं सुरु आहेत. दिल्ली पोलिसांना हाताशी धरून हे सरकार फक्त आंदोलकांना  चिरडत होतं असं नाही तर हे आंदोलन कव्हर करणाऱ्या महिला पत्रकारांचा पण छळ करत होतं. 

आज दिल्लीत आंदोलनं होतील या भीतीने दिल्लीत मेट्रो सेवा बंद केलीत, रस्ते अडवलेत, इंटरनेट सेवा बंद केली आहे, बस सेवा थांबवली आहे, आंदोलकांना विमानातून उचलून नेलं जात आहे. ही कोणती पद्धत ? देशातील २०,३० वर्षांचे तरुण तरुणी अस्वस्थ आहेत, त्यांना त्यांचं भविष्य दिसत नाहीये, म्हणून ती शांततेत रस्त्यावर उतरून आंदोलन करत आहेत आणि तुम्ही त्यांनाच चिरडायचा प्रयत्न करताय? जगभर मोदी जाऊन आमच्या देशात लोकशाही आहे हे आता कोणत्या तोंडाने सांगणार आहेत ? ही असली लोकशाही? 

मला समजत नाही या ज्ञानेश कुमारबद्दल इतकं प्रेम का ? ज्ञानेश कुमार आणि त्या आधीचे निवडणूक अधिकारी हे तुमचे सत्ता काबीज करण्याचे मार्ग आहेत म्हणून ? निवडणूक आयोग एक स्वायत्त संस्था आहे, त्याच्या प्रमुखाने काही गोंधळ घातला असेल तर त्याचा राजीनामा व्हायलाच हवा. तसंच संपूर्ण निवडणूक यंत्रणा ही प्रामाणिक आणि पारदर्शक असायला हवी या मागणीत गैर ते काय ? माझ्या मताचा अधिकार काढून घेतला जातोय, किंवा माझं मत कुठे आणि कोणाला जातंय हे मला समजत नाहीये. आणि त्यातून माझ्या मताचा अपमान होतोय हा राग व्यक्त करण्याचा अधिकार पण नसावा ? का वरच्या दोघांना भीती आहे की ज्ञानेश कुमारला राजीनामा द्यायला लागला आणि त्याने माझे मतचोरीचे करवते धनी कोण हे जर सांगितलं तर आत्तापर्यंतचं सत्तेचं सगळंच बिंग फुटेल म्हणून! 

भारतीय राज्यघटनेच्या कलम १९ (१) (अ) आणि (ब) यानुसार नागरिकांना शांततेत निदर्शनं करण्याचा पूर्ण अधिकार आहे. हा अधिकार तुम्हाला का चिरडायचा आहे ? काल तर चक्क माननीय सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाने देखील विचारलं, माशी मारायला हातोडा कशाला वापरताय ?. बरं आंदोलकांना ताब्यात घेतलं आणि सोडून दिलं असं सहसा महाराष्ट्रात पोलीस डिपार्टमेंट करतं. आणि हे करताना नागरिकांच्या संविधानिक अधिकारांना धक्का बसणार नाही हे पाहतात. पण इथे दिल्लीत तर महिला पत्रकार ज्या हे आंदोलन कव्हर करत होत्या, त्यांच्या तक्रारी आहेत की पोलिसांनी स्थानबद्ध केल्यावर त्यांचा छळ केला म्हणून. जर आंदोलन कव्हर करणाऱ्यांचा छळ होत असेल तर आंदोलकांना नीट वागवतील याची काय खात्री ? 

या देशातील तरुणांनी तुम्हाला झुकवलं आणि धर्मेंद्र प्रधान यांचा राजीनामा घ्यायला लावला हा राग अजून शमला नाहीये असं दिसतंय. अण्णा हजारे आंदोलनाच्या वेळेस मोदी-शाह गुजरातमध्ये आंदोलनं होऊ देत होते कारण ती फायद्याची होती. पण त्याच गुजरातमध्ये त्यांनी सत्तेच्या काळात त्यांच्या सरकारच्या विरोधातील अनेक आंदोलनं चिरडली. थोडक्यात हे बेगडी आणि दुटप्पी आहेत हे स्पष्ट दिसतंय. 

नेटफ्लिक्सवर एक डॉक्युमेंट्री आहे, How to Become a Tyrant (tyarant म्हणजे जुलमी शासक ) ही डॉक्युमेंट्री बहुदा अमित शाह रोज गांभीर्याने बघत आहेत असं दिसतंय. त्यापेक्षा ज्या गुजरातमधून तुम्ही येता त्याच राज्यातून आलेल्या महात्मा गांधींनी शांततेतली केलेल्या आंदोलनांबद्दल आणि स्वातंत्र्य चळवळीबद्दल जरा वाचा. अर्थात यांच्याकडून मी अपेक्षा का बाळगतोय हेच समजत नाही ! असो . . .

Nana is gone, but the man he portrayed on screen remains all around us. His anger remains, as does his restlessness, his humiliation, his struggle, and that intermittent surge of strength to confront his circumstances. Perhaps that is why, in bidding farewell to Nana, we are not merely parting with a great actor. We are parting with a face embodying the countless pent-up emotions of ordinary people.

Heartfelt tributes to Nana Patekar on behalf of the Maharashtra Navnirman Sena.

Raj Thackeray

rawContent:
Veteran actor Nana Patekar has passed away.

The Hindi film industry and Mumbai share an inseparable bond. When one speaks of Mumbai, it encompasses its theatre, its world of commercial cinema, and the middle and lower-middle classes striving daily to carve out their identity, from slums to chawls. Then came the working class that gradually faced ruin in this city and across the country; the rise of the underworld born out of that social despair; the period where communal harmony unraveled before our eyes; followed by the post-liberalization expansion of middle-class aspirations and the politics swirling around it all. Through every such era, Nana Patekar made his presence felt, sometimes on stage, sometimes on screen. From ‘Hamidabai Chi Kothi’ to ‘Parinda’, ‘Krantiveer’, ‘Ab Tak Chhappan’, and all the way to ‘Natasamrat’, Nana remained ever-present. Across each phase, he brought to life, whether on the screen or the stage, the common man living with persistent inner turmoil.

Anger, humiliation, powerlessness, despair, revulsion toward immorality, disillusionment with the system, and class struggle constantly simmer within the mind of the common man. It spills over only occasionally through petty arguments or domestic turmoil. Otherwise, it stays bottled up inside. Watching Nana perform felt like looking into this emotional pressure cooker of ordinary lives. When Nana, or the 'Angry Young Man' Amitabh Bachchan, confronted these realities on screen, they vented the steam trapped within the human psyche. As I often say, just as singers and composers like Lata didi, Asha tai, Kishore Kumar, and Rafi sahab, along with filmmakers, playwrights, directors, and artists, entertained Indian minds for at least 60 to 70 years, figures like Nana and Bachchan Sahab powerfully released that inner steam on screen. Had they not done so, chaos might have erupted in this country every month.

Watching Nana act always reminded me of Hollywood's Morgan Freeman. Neither fit the conventional type of Bollywood or Hollywood actors of their times in terms of looks or persona. Watching Morgan Freeman, one often feels this is a man who has absorbed wisdom, patience, and a quiet acceptance of things as they are over time. With Nana's acting, however, I sensed fury, restlessness, and a deeply entrenched despair. Freeman represents a man who seems to have seen it all; Nana represents a man who has endured too much and can take no more. These are two opposite ends of the human spectrum. Because Nana could bring that second extreme to the screen with raw authenticity, he was a truly great artist.

In the 2000s, polished, fair, and conventional leading men began making way for story-driven cinema, ushering in an era of character actors who could carry a narrative and draw audiences on merit. Nana was undoubtedly the pioneer of this era. The prominence that character actors enjoy today was paved by Nana.

Yet, despite all this, he was fiercely individualistic, spoke his mind without filter, and was outspoken (though it hardly suits me to call anyone outspoken; be that as it may). Because of this, even when producers and directors wished to cast him, they often hesitated. Did this hurt Nana? One cannot say; he remained indifferent. But it certainly deprived Hindi cinema and its audience. While Nawazuddin Siddiqui and the late Irrfan Khan were undoubtedly brilliant performers, one wonders whether they and others like them would have found those same opportunities had Nana been willing to compromise. Moreover, Nana was not confined to aggressive or intense roles, through films like ‘Welcome’, he demonstrated to the world that he could handle comedy with equal prowess.

ज्येष्ठ अभिनेते नाना पाटेकर यांचं निधन झालं. हिंदी चित्रपट सृष्टी म्हणजे मुंबई हे दृढ समीकरण. मुंबई आली की इथली रंगभूमी, इथलं व्यावसायिक सिनेमाचं जग, इथल्या झोपडीपासून, चाळीपासून कुठेतरी रोज या शहरात स्वतःचं अस्तित्व शोधण्याचा प्रयत्न करणारा इथला मध्यमवर्ग, निम्न मध्यमवर्ग आला, पुढे याच शहरातला आणि हळूहळू या देशातील उध्वस्त होत गेलेला कामगार वर्ग आला, त्यातून आलेल्या सामाजिक नैराश्यातून उदयाला आलेलं अंडरर्वल्डचं विश्व असेल, सामाजिक सलोखा बघता बघता विस्कटून जाण्याचा काळ असेल, पुढे याच मध्यमवर्गाच्या आकांक्षा उदारीकरणानंतर विस्तारत जाणं आणि या सगळ्याच्या भोवती फिरणारं राजकारण. या प्रत्येक टप्प्यात नाना पाटेकर कधी नाटकातून कधी सिनेमातून दिसले. हमीदाबाईची कोठीपासून ते परिंदा ते क्रांतिवीर ते अब तक छप्पन ते अगदी नटसम्राटपर्यंत प्रत्येक ठिकाणी नाना पाटेकर दिसत राहिले . या प्रत्येक टप्प्यावरची कुठेतरी अस्वस्थता उराशी घेऊन जगणारा सामान्य माणूस नाना पाटेकर कधी पडद्यावर तर कधी रंगभूमीवर उभा करत राहिले .

सामान्य माणसाच्या मनात सातत्याने राग, अपमान, शक्तिहीनता, नैराश्य, अनैतिक गोष्टींबद्दलची घृणा, व्यवस्थेबद्दलची निराशा, वर्ग संघर्ष हे सगळं आत धुमसत असतं. ते अगदी कधीतरी किरकोळ भांडणं किंवा घरातील आदळआपट यातून बाहेर पडतं, अन्यथा ते आत धुमसत राहतं. हे धुमसत राहणं, प्रेशर कुकर सारखं आत रटरटत राहणं हेच त्याच्या वाट्याला येतं. नानांच्या अभिनयाकडे बघताना हा सामान्यांच्या आयुष्यातला भावनांचा प्रेशर कुकर बघतोय असं वाटायचं. आणि मग कधीकधी नाना असतील किंवा अँग्री यंग मॅन अमिताभ बच्चन असतील यांनी पडद्यावर केलेले दोन हात ही माणसाच्या मनाच्या प्रेशर कुकरमधील वाफ बाहेर काढतात. मी जसं नेहमी म्हणतो की लतादीदी, आशाताई, किशोर कुमार, रफी साहेब, इत्यादी गायकांनी ,संगीतकारांनी, चित्रपट तसेच नाटक निर्माते,दिग्दर्शक, कलाकारांनी भारतीयांचं किमान ६०/७० वर्ष मन रिझवलं तसंच नाना असतील किंवा बच्चन साहेब असतील यांनी आतली वाफ पडद्यावर ताकदीने बाहेर काढली म्हणून ठीक नाही तर या देशांत दर महिन्याला अराजकता निर्माण झाली असती.

नानांच्या अभिनयाकडे बघताना मला नेहमीच हॉलिवूडमधल्या मॉर्गन फ्रीमन यांची आठवण येते. रूप असेल व्यक्तिमत्व असेल दोघेही तत्कालीन बॉलिवूड किंवा हॉलिवूडच्या कलाकाराच्या पठडीत बसणारे अभिनेते नाहीत. मॉर्गन फ्रीमन यांच्याकडे पाहिल्यानंतर अनेकदा असं वाटतं की या माणसाने काळाच्या ओघात शहाणपण, पेशन्स, आणि आहे हे हे असं आहे हे स्वीकारलेपण आत्मसात केलं आहे. तर नानांच्या अभियाकडे पाहून मला राग, चंचलता, आणि खूप खोल साठलेलं नैराश्य जाणवायचं.  या माणसाने खूप बघितलंय असं वाटणारा मॉर्गन फ्रीमन आणि या माणसाने खूप भोगलंय आता बस असं वाटणारे नाना. माणसाची दोन टोकाची रूपं असतात. यातलं दुसरं टोक नाना मनस्वीपणे पडद्यावर आणू शकायचे म्हणून ते मोठे कलाकार होते. 

२००० च्या दशकांत गोरे गोमटे आखीव रेखीव गुळगुळीत दिसणाऱ्या नटांच्या ऐवजी कथा ही सिनेमाच्या पटावर आली आणि ती कथा सांगणारे नट आणि प्रेक्षकाला ओढून आणणारे नट यांच्या चलतीचा काळ सुरु झाला. आणि या युगाचे पहिले नायक १००% नाना होते. आज चरित्र अभिनेत्यांची जी चलती दिसत आहे, त्याला वाट नानांनी करून दिली. 

पण इतकं सगळं असून देखील त्यांचा स्वभाव मनस्वी होता, मनात येईल ते बोलायचे, फटकळ होता (खरंतर मी कोणाला फटकळ म्हणणं चुकीचंच आहे. असो) यामुळे नानांना चित्रपटात घ्यायची इच्छा असली तरी निर्माते दिग्दर्शक टाळायचे, याने नानांचं नुकसान झालं का ? माहित नाही, ते बेफिकीर होते. पण १००% हिंदी चित्रपटसृष्टीचं आणि प्रेक्षकांच नुकसान झालं. नवाझउद्दीन सिद्दीकी किंवा इरफान खान( जे आज आपल्यात नाहीत) हे तसे उत्तम कलाकार, परंतु नानांनी काही गोष्टी ॲडजस्ट केल्या असत्या तर कदाचित या आणि अशा काही कलाकारांना ज्या संधी मिळाल्या त्या मिळाल्या असत्या का, याबद्दल मनात शंका निर्माण होते. नानांनी नुसताच आक्रमक किंवा गंभीर अभिनय केला नाही तर वेलकम चित्रपटातून त्यांनी विनोदी भूमिका देखील तितक्याच ताकदीने उभ्या करू शकतो हे जगाला दाखवले   ! 

नाना गेले, पण नानांनी पडद्यावर उभा केलेला तो माणूस अजूनही आपल्या आजूबाजूला आहे. त्याचा राग आहे, त्याची अस्वस्थता आहे, त्याचा अपमान आहे, त्याची धडपड आहे आणि परिस्थितीशी दोन हात करण्याची त्याची अधूनमधून उसळणारी ताकदही आहे. कदाचित म्हणूनच नानांना निरोप देताना केवळ एका मोठ्या अभिनेत्याला आपण निरोप देत नाही आहोत तर समाजातल्या सामान्य माणसाच्या मनात साठत गेलेल्या असंख्य भावनांचा एक चेहरा आज आपल्यातून निघून गेला आहे.

नाना पाटेकरांना महाराष्ट्र नवनिर्माण सेनेतर्फे भावपूर्ण श्रद्धांजली 

राज ठाकरे ।

Clarification

A video is being recirculated on social media in which an individual falsely claims to be a Delhi Police Sub Inspector who recently resigned from service to join the ongoing protest.

Verification of Delhi Police records has revealed no Sub Inspector matching the details claimed in the video. The claim is therefore unverified and misleading.

Legal action will be taken as per law against those found responsible for creating or circulating misleading content.

Delhi Police had already issued a clarification on this matter on 24 July 2026 , and this time the same video is again being circulated with the malicious intent.

The public is advised to rely only on verified official information and refrain from sharing unverified claims.

rawContent:
🔸Under the directions of Hon’ble Shri Deven Bharti, @CPMumbaiPolice, Grievance Redressal Day was organised on Saturday, 10th October 2026, across all police stations under the supervision of the Joint Commissioner of Police (Law & Order).

Additional Commissioners of Police and Deputy Commissioners of Police visited police stations to review the proceedings and guide the officers. Assistant Commissioners of Police and Senior Police Inspectors addressed citizens’ grievances, took appropriate action on applications, and ensured necessary action in registered cases and reported crimes.

Your safety and grievances remain our priority. In cases of crimes against women, citizens are urged to contact our helpline 1090 or dial 100/112 for assistance.

🔸मा. श्री. देवेन भारती, @CPMumbaiPolice यांच्या निर्देशानुसार, शनिवार, दि. १० ऑक्टोबर २०२६ रोजी सह पोलीस आयुक्त (कायदा व सुव्यवस्था) यांच्या देखरेखीखाली मुंबईतील सर्व पोलीस ठाण्यांमध्ये तक्रार निवारण दिनाचे आयोजन करण्यात आले.

या वेळी अपर पोलीस आयुक्त व पोलीस उपआयुक्त यांनी पोलीस ठाण्यांना भेट देऊन कामकाजाचा आढावा घेतला व अधिकाऱ्यांना आवश्यक मार्गदर्शन केले. सहाय्यक पोलीस आयुक्त व वरिष्ठ पोलीस निरीक्षक यांनी नागरिकांच्या तक्रारींचे निवारण केले, अर्जांवर योग्य ती कार्यवाही केली तसेच नोंदविलेल्या गुन्ह्यांमध्ये व प्राप्त तक्रारींमध्ये आवश्यक ती कारवाई सुनिश्चित केली.

आपली सुरक्षितता आणि आपल्या तक्रारींचे निवारण हे आमचे प्राधान्य आहे. महिलांविरुद्धच्या गुन्ह्यांसंदर्भात मदतीसाठी नागरिकांनी हेल्पलाईन क्रमांक १०९० वर संपर्क साधावा किंवा १००/११२ या क्रमांकांवर संपर्क साधावा.

#MumbaiPolice4All

⚠️ Stay alert:
❌ Don’t reply to suspicious messages
❌ Don’t open unknown attachments or links
❌ Never share OTP, PIN or passwords
✅ Verify transactions only through your bank’s official app/website.

rawContent:
1. This is the season for looking at Narendra Modi’s 25 years in power, & beyond. His followers are celebrating. His Cabinet has passed a resolution praising him. Critics are dissecting his quarter century in public life, not with a scalpel but with a scythe. But the Modi-BJP story is still the most significant. It just isn’t as dominant as before. Multiple headwinds create the turbulence Modi is battling as he steps into his 26th year in public office. #NationalInterest
 
2. This has brought the so far all-conquering, 3-point Modi proposition under the greatest pressure since 2014: Hard, Hinduised nationalism; ever-expanding welfare, distributed efficiently, with minimal leakage; & visible construction of physical infrastructure. All of this without a significant overhang of corruption.
 
3. The Modi proposition survives. It’s just that several factors have now emerged. We aren’t just talking about the rebellion of an irreverential, ageist, educated, & mostly not-impoverished Gen-Z. In isolation, each of these factors may look small. But they become formidable when the big picture comes together. As the great management guru late CK Prahalad used to say, ‘weak signals add up to a big change’. Is this what Modi is confronted with now? 
 
4. From dramatic damage to the credibility of the EC, inflation, & small allies speaking out to Rahul Gandhi getting prominent space on TV channels & Hindi newspapers — including the ones ‘most trusted’ by the establishment — and a global situation for India not seen in decades, Modi is faced with the Shakespearean ‘battalions of sorrows’.
 
5. The larger issues, however, are rooted in the 3 most fundamental factors that have made India cohesive & stronger over the decades: Trust in the Constitution & the belief that nobody can take it away; fairness of the top judiciary; & independence of the EC. All 3 are under strain now.
 
6. These are the challenges Modi needs to address as he steps into his 26th unbroken year in public office. If he doesn’t, or fails to do so, CK Prahalad’s small signals theory shows that a dramatic crisis awaits Modi in the two and a half years until the summer of 2029.

Last evening, signed off as 🇧🇩 High Commissioner to India.
Ended an eighteen month stint (April '25 - Oct '26), marked with times/episodes like hardly ever before (as most noted). Such were times that would fit into an examination of '#diplomacy in crisis' (without marked conflict). Yet, ...
It's mostly a solitary walk. On most occasions, 'briefs' or (previous) precedents would hardly suffice/suggest.
My limited experience merely asked me to keep walking regardless of what naysayers may say and populate the space, to touch #people and their mindscape. Just no grand scheme. Looking back, "there's no dull day", as @CSDR_India | @IndiasWorld_mag headlined (May '26).
This morning, feels like, I survived many intense episodes when I risked being mis-understood. For me as a diplomat, it's testing endurance | patience | composure yet being able to ask/plea all to hold on the shared space for 🇧🇩 🇮🇳 ordinary people, in shared interests.
Yes, its easier said than done. But, irrespective of views one is sovereign to, must pledge to, given the shared agro-ecology we belong to, forever tied to.
I thank scores of friends who quietly lend their shoulders (or may be, believed in my 'two cents'). 
@MEAIndia @bdhc_delhi

rawContent:
1. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio delivered a speech from the birthplace of democracy. In Athens, he advocated for Trump’s policies, made the case for America First, urged Europe to awaken from slumber & attacked Iran’s ‘radical mullahs’. #CutTheClutter looks at the speech’s significance, its implications, & explains why it was a 2028 campaign speech disguised as statecraft.
 
2. Rubio’s central message to Europe was unmistakable. The West, he warned, must decide whether it intends to retain its place at the head of the world or resign itself to “servitude, atrophy and decline”. The other standout argument was that power is not simply about possessing capabilities. It is about convincing others that you are willing to use them. This applies to, for example, military force, trade leverage & tariffs.
 
3. There was also a defence of Trump’s transactional foreign policy. Rubio invoked Greenland, arguing that confrontation had eventually produced a settlement in which the US, Denmark & Greenland all emerged with gains. Rubio attacked Iran’s “radical mullahs”, portraying their ideology as one that glorifies death & martyrdom. He contrasted this with the Western ideal of heroes willing to die for a cause but not worshipping death itself.
 
4. Rubio’s speech was carefully constructed: The ancient setting, the references to Greek democracy & Rome, the invocation of Christianity, the language of duty & heroism. And that’s where 2028 enters the picture. Rubio has been a Republican presidential contender, & this certainly seemed to be a 2028 campaign speech wrapped in the very gentle language of diplomacy.
 
5. What does his speech mean for India?
·        Trumpism won’t disappear after Trump. If Republicans return, a Rubio- or Vance-led govt could preserve much of this agenda, albeit in a different tone. Even a Democratic administration may retain parts of these policies.
·        US focus on supply chains, re-industrialisation, military strength, tech dominance, AI, strategic autonomy, & critical minerals are not just Trump’s passing fancy, US policy will be built around them. India can live with this as long as it is seen an ally, friend or useful.
·        CNP or comprehensive national power. India needs to look at this. CNP is not just military strength, it’s also size of the economy, tech capability, industrial depth, critical-mineral security & quality of human resources.
